prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: conceptual pixel-art game UI for PLAGUEFALL, Brazilian sertão industrial cyberpunk Sega Mega Drive game. Create ONE flat front-facing complete game screen, landscape 10:7 aspect ratio, composed like a native 320x224 screen enlarged 4x with crisp square pixels. Not a photograph of a device, no perspective, no room, no CRT blur, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing. Rich but restrained 16-bit pixel art: dark charcoal/black inset monitor, worn gunmetal and rusty bronze riveted border, copper pipes and small amber indicator lights around all four edges. Black interior, large legible uppercase pale-yellow pixel type, gray secondary labels. Match the game's existing radio console aesthetic. The interior should stay clear and spacious and prioritize readable labels, strong icon silhouettes, and orderly alignment. All content inside safe margins. No portraits, no characters, no logos, no extra words, no watermark. These are design concepts, not emulator screenshots. Primary request: screen that shows a continuation password for the resistance radio, named Sinal do Último Chão. Exact title in the top bar: "SINAL DO ÚLTIMO CHÃO". Under the title, small line "GUARDE ESTA SEQUÊNCIA". Center: SIX framed pictogram cells arranged TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, numbered 1 to 6 in reading order, with easily recognizable colored pixel-art icons and their exact uppercase labels below each icon: row1 left a brown northeastern cangaceiro leather hat with pale metal studs "CHAPÉU"; row1 right a compact improvised military radio with antenna and amber display "RÁDIO"; row2 left glowing orange embers "BRASA"; row2 right a respectful tiny icon of Nossa Senhora Aparecida, dark blue triangular mantle and gold crown, "SANTA"; row3 left rusty copper pliers "ALICATE"; row3 right a green branching mandacaru cactus "MANDACARU". Give all six icons equal weight and large identifiable silhouettes. Two narrow lines below grid, exact text: "RETOMAR: FASE 7" and "DO INÍCIO DA MISSÃO". Footer exact text: "FOTOGRAFE OU ANOTE" and "A: SEGUIR". No invented password letters or numbers beyond the six small position numbers.

Use case: ui-mockup. Edit target: the provided Sinal do Último Chão radio screen. Create the matching PASSWORD ENTRY screen. Preserve the complete rusty gunmetal/copper radio frame, landscape 10:7 proportions, black background, pale-yellow uppercase pixel typography, amber lights, crisp 16-bit visual style, identical six pictograms and consistent icon design. Change top title to exact "CONTINUAR POR CÓDIGO". Subtitle exact "MONTE A SEQUÊNCIA DO SEU SINAL". Keep the six numbered cells arranged TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS and their icons in the same reading order: 1 CHAPÉU, 2 RÁDIO, 3 BRASA, 4 SANTA, 5 ALICATE, 6 MANDACARU. Make cell 3 the currently edited selection: bright yellow rectangular outline, small up and down pixel arrows at its right edge, tiny label "3/6" beside the outline. The other five outlines are dim bronze, all labels readable. Keep the selected fire icon contained inside its cell. Replace the stage information at the bottom with the exact text "ESCOLHA OS SEIS SÍMBOLOS". Footer in two compact legible lines: "ESQ/DIR: POSIÇÃO   CIMA/BAIXO: SÍMBOLO" and "A: CONFERIR   B: VOLTAR". Rebalance spacing slightly if necessary while preserving the same shell, full screen visible, generous safe margins. No portraits, no fake gameplay, no touchscreen keyboard, no realistic controller, no watermark. This is a conceptual pixel-art game interface, no claim of a runtime screenshot.

Use case: ui-mockup. Edit target: the provided Sinal do Último Chão radio screen. Create its matching SUCCESS / RESUME CONFIRMATION screen. Preserve the complete rusty gunmetal and copper radio shell, black monitor, landscape 10:7 framing, crisp square-pixel 16-bit art, amber lamps and pale-yellow uppercase pixel typography. Change the top title to exact "SINAL RECONHECIDO". Replace the 2-column symbol grid with a spacious centered confirmation: a compact olive-green resistance radio icon with aerial and amber display at upper center, with three small amber signal waves above it. Below exact large text "FASE 7" and "ÚLTIMO CHÃO". Then a thin bronze divider, followed by two clear lines "RETOMAR DO INÍCIO DA FASE" and "VIDA CHEIA • SUPRIMENTOS PADRÃO", latter in subdued gray. Near bottom of black monitor show the six matching recognizable password icons as one small horizontal row, in the EXACT same order as the original grid reading order: cangaceiro leather hat, radio, embers, Nossa Senhora Aparecida statue, pliers, mandacaru cactus; no labels required for this small confirmation strip, no extra symbol. Bottom two menu choices inside the frame: highlighted pale-yellow "> CONTINUAR" and dim-gray "VOLTAR". Footer exact "A: CONFIRMAR   B: VOLTAR". No portraits, no new gameplay, no photographic realism, no extra text, no watermark. This is an illustrative UI proposal.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a concept atlas of sixteen password pictograms for PLAGUEFALL, a Brazilian cangaço cyberpunk Mega Drive game set in an industrial sertão. Create ONE landscape 10:7 image with a dark charcoal/black background and a thin worn gunmetal and oxidized bronze border, tiny amber indicator lamps, pale-yellow uppercase pixel type. Flat front view, crisp square pixels, limited 16-bit game color style, deliberate clean large silhouettes, avoid tiny noisy details, no antialiasing, no photography, no gradients, no perspective. Title at top exact "ALFABETO DO SINAL". Inside, EXACTLY SIXTEEN evenly spaced square cells in FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, each with a single colored pixel-art icon and its exact pale-yellow name directly below; equal scale/visual weight and generous spacing. Reading order: row1: MANDACARU (green branching cactus), ENGRENAGEM (rusty steel cog), SANTA (respectful Nossa Senhora Aparecida statue in dark-blue mantle and gold crown), SAÚVA (recognizable rust-red leafcutter ant with six legs); row2: CHAPÉU (northeastern cangaceiro brown leather hat with metal star studs), RÁDIO (compact olive-green improvised two-way radio, aerial, amber display), CAPELA (small whitewashed northeastern chapel with cross and blue door), MUTUCA (dark blue-gray stout horsefly with two wings and six legs, distinct from the ant); row3: BARRO (reddish-brown cracked-earth clod), FOGUETE (industrial silver rocket with copper fins), EX-VOTO (small carved wooden anatomical heart devotional offering, no gore), ESCORPIÃO (ochre-yellow scorpion with two claws and arched stinger); row4: CORDEL (small folded cream chapbook with red binding and bold dark woodcut marks), ALICATE (steel pliers with copper-brown handles), SINO (aged bronze bell), BRASA (glowing red-orange coals and a few short flames). No digits, no duplicate objects, no additional icons, no portraits, no watermark. Labels must be correctly spelled in Brazilian Portuguese and associated only with their own cell. Concept reference sheet, not a technical sprite export or runtime screenshot.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the 4-by-4 ALFABETO DO SINAL atlas. Image 2 is the SOURCE OF EXACT SYMBOL DESIGNS: the SINAL DO ÚLTIMO CHÃO screen. Preserve image 1 layout, dimensions, title, all sixteen cell positions, all labels, frame, background, and the ten other symbols without any change. Replace ONLY the artwork inside these SIX cells of the atlas with the corresponding recognizable design from image 2, scaled proportionally to fit the same atlas cells: MANDACARU row1 col1 (same branching cactus with small rocky base); SANTA row1 col3 (same dark blue mantle statue and crown); CHAPÉU row2 col1 (same cangaceiro hat with round studs and stars); RÁDIO row2 col2 (the SAME WIDE horizontal olive-green radio with handle, shoulder strap, amber display, circular tuning dial and thin aerial, NOT a narrow handheld walkie-talkie); ALICATE row4 col2 (same horizontal steel pliers pointing left, brown handles pointing right); BRASA row4 col4 (same red-orange coals with short central flame). Keep all exact text and all untouched icons. Maintain crisp pixel art, dark black monitor, clean silhouettes and matched visual weight. No added letters, no extra objects, no photorealism. This corrects consistency between the concept screen and the proposed password alphabet.
